newsitem.title: CANADA: Moore Corp to buy back 12 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Moore Corp to buy back 12 million shares.

text.p: Moore Corp Ltd confirmed on Wednesday it will buy back 12 million common shares at a price of C$30.50 under its offer that expired May 21.

Moore said 12,102,777 shares were deposited pursuant to the offer at or below C$30.50. It said such shares will therefore be subject to a proration factor of about 99 percent, other than odd lots of less than 100 shares which will not be subject to proration.
Moore said payment for shares properly deposited will be made on May 30.

As a result of the share purchase, the number of common shares outstanding will be reduced by about 12 percent to about 88 million common shares from about 100 million common shares prior to the offer.
